Feature.Description: Contains an observable command that raises a recoverable error for testing the "Error Recovery Service" core feature (v 2.0).

Command.Description: Raises a recoverable error with the error message 'SiLA 2 recoverable error for test' after the specified duration containing the following continuation options: - Identifier = 'OptionA', Description = 'Recover the error by choosing option A', - Identifier = 'OptionB', Description = 'Recover the error by choosing option B', - Identifier = 'OptionC', Description = 'Recover the error by choosing option C' and OptionB marked as the default option. Returns the identifier of the continuation option which has been selected to handle the error.

Parameter.Description: The duration in seconds before the recoverable error is raised.
The duration in seconds after the specified default option is automatically selected (0 means no automatic execution).

Response.Description: The identifier of the continuation option which has been selected to handle the error.
